style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, soft warm oat-beige #F3EFE3 for benefit and info screens, warm natural wood #C9A87C and woven rattan #D8C4A0 for scene shots
style.direction: fresh tropical fruit commerce, orchard-to-table warmth
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular icon badges and thin arc connector lines in #7BA83E
style.lightingSystem: bright soft top-front daylight around 5500K with a gentle fill, soft natural contact shadows, light dewy highlight on the skin and a gentle sheen on the flesh, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh tropical fruit commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft warm oat-beige #F3EFE3, charcoal-brown text #2E2A22 and one fresh green accent #7BA83E; warm tone; bright soft top-front daylight around 5500K with a gentle fill, soft natural contact shadows and dewy highlights on the fruit; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-brown #2E2A22, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt, one family across the set; consistent rounded info labels and single-weight thin-line circular icon badges in #7BA83E with thin arc connector lines; surfaces of matte white ceramic #FFFFFF, warm natural wood #C9A87C and woven bamboo-rattan #D8C4A0; clean high-end fresh-produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable fruit scale and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle; round fruit always stacked in a loose natural pile grounded by a contact shadow; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: consistent fruit scale and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle across the set; every fruit pile grounded by a contact shadow, never floating; round fruit stacked in a loose natural pile; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte white ceramic plate #FFFFFF, warm natural wood tabletop #C9A87C and woven bamboo-rattan mat #D8C4A0
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-brown #2E2A22, headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, one family for the whole set, no decorative, handwritten or retro styles
